requirement: An individual with stress shall be able to edit a check in question they did that day when selecting edit to change a response about their stressors
source: Elicitation Interview with Stella & my decision
measurement_method: acceptance criteria AC-004..006

requirement: An individual with stress shall be able to see how many check ins they completed through a toast when they submit a check in
measurement_method: acceptance criteria AC-007..008

requirement: An individual with stress shall be able to see how their stress is doing from the results of the check ins in weekly/monthly views when they open up the weekly/monthly views on the overview page
source: Elicitation Interview with Stella & my decision & The next maintainer
measurement_method: acceptance criteria AC-009..011

requirement: An individual with stress shall be able to choose stress relieving based goals either a predetermined one or custom written one for the week and month when they enter in the overview page
source: Elicitation Interview with Stella & my decision
measurement_method: acceptance criteria AC-012..013

requirement: An individual with stress shall be able to add in a journal entry that describes their stress and stressors when a journal entry box is clicked
measurement_method: acceptance criteria AC-014..017

requirement: An individual with stress shall be able to edit a journal entry they did that day when it is clicked to include more about what is stressing them or to add in things that are stressing them
measurement_method: acceptance criteria AC-018..020

requirement: An individual with stress shall be able to see the word count when writing a journal entry about their stress
measurement_method: acceptance criteria AC-021..022

requirement: An individual with stress shall be able to click/play a destressing activity when they choose one out of one of the sections choices
measurement_method: acceptance criteria AC-023..025

requirement: An individual with stress shall be able to click an option to get a random automatic destressing activity option when the pop up appears and that directs the individual to the activity that was randomly chosen when clicked on
measurement_method: acceptance criteria AC-026..027

requirement: An individual with stress shall be able to click from a predetermined prompt to ask AI for a suggestion based explanation of their stress when they open the AI Analysis page
measurement_method: acceptance criteria AC-028..31

requirement: An individual with stress shall be able to click from a predetermined prompt to ask AI for a suggestion for destressing aid when they open the AI Analysis page
measurement_method: acceptance criteria AC-032..35

requirement: Stressed individuals shall be able to get a response from the AI Analysis in a p95 under 25 seconds when there is at least 1 check in and journal entry recorded on an iPhone with throttled "Fast 3G" connection in Expo Go
measurement_method: Measured with 20 prompts to the AI Analysis and recording the p95 result in `docs/measurements.md` expecting that it is under 25

requirement: Stressed individuals shall be able to run the app 9 out of 10 times when entering it with 0 unhandled exceptions and errors
measurement_method: Measured with 10 opening and closings of the app and the times it succeeded vs failed which expects 9 successes out of the 10

requirement: When Gemini is unavailable the app shall display the predetermined fallback response within 30 seconds for 10 out of 10 simulated failures
measurement_method: Measured by testing with a simulated timeout an API error and an invalid response then recording whether the fallback appears as expected in 10 simulated failures

requirement: Stressed individuals data shall be breached 0 times when the repository has 0 AI API key's in any commit
measurement_method: Measured by scanning over the full history going over every commit made to GitHub and checking that the .env is in the gitignore and expecting that there are 0 secrets found when this is done

requirement: The app shall expose 0 technical error details API keys database errors or provider error details in 10 simulated failure cases instead it will proved general error messages
measurement_method: Measured by simulating 10 save API and database failures then expecting that 0 are recorded with contain technical error details API keys or database information

requirement: Stressed individuals check in responses and journal entries shall be sent to Gemini AI 0 times unless the stressed individual prompts for an AI Analysis request
measurement_method: Measured by checking the AI request page after doing 7 check ins and 7 journal entries expecting that the responses and entries were sent 0 times to Gemini AI

requirement: Each AI request shall send only the check-in responses journal entry and the predetermined prompt when prompted for that analysis. It shall send 0 unrelated personal information or device information
measurement_method: Measured by sending 10 test requests with sample data checking each request to make sure it includes 0 unrelated information

requirement: Stressed individuals shall be able to go through each 5 main features in the app with 0 problems as each will have easy readable fonts and text size and contrasts in colors
measurement_method: Measured with 5 individuals that go through the app with the grayscale setting on expecting 4 out the 5 individuals have 0 problems going through the app

requirement: The app shall show success failure and loading states and message without relying on color alone in 5 out of the 5 tests
measurement_method: Measured by turning on the grayscale mode and checking the 5 main features expecting the recording shows that 0 main feature rely on color alone and that all 5 main feature pass the 5 tests

requirement: Stressed individuals first time on the app 4 out of 5 of them shall be able to complete 1 check in journal entry and AI Anylsis prompt request when they go through the app without help
measurement_method: Measured with 5 first time stressed individuals app usage completion expecting 4 passing out of 5

requirement: Stressed individuals first time on the app 4 out of 5 of them shall be able to correctly identify whether a journal entry or check-in was saved after both a successful and failed save attempt
measurement_method: Measured with 5 users in both scenarios with 0 assistance and recording their answers

requirement: New stressed individuals shall be able to use only the README when creating a clean clone of the repository to reach a running app in under 10 minutes with 0 errors
measurement_method: Measured through testing this on a clean computer and that the app works on an iPhone in Expo Go recording how long it took which expects under 10 mintues and expecting 0 errors

requirement: Stressed individuals shall be able to run the app and complete the a least 1 check in journal entry and AI Anaylsis when on 2 different operting systems both iOS and Android
measurement_method: Measured through testing and recording that each feature works on an iPhone and Android expecting that all 5 main features have 0 errors

requirement: The app shall work when in portrait mode and cut of 0 main buttons or controls
measurement_method: Measured by testing every main screen in portrait mode expecting that all 5 main feautre work recording any controls that are cut off or cannot be reached though expecting 0 fail to work

requirement: The app shall work when in landscape mode and cut of 0 main buttons or controls
measurement_method: Measured by testing every main screen in landscape mode expecting that all 5 main feautre work recording any controls that are cut off or cannot be reached though expecting 0 fail to appear or work properly
